summary: Health workers in communities worldwide can provide better care with the help of digital health apps built using the Community Health Toolkit's Core Framework. This software architecture simplifies the development of scalable digital health apps that support team-based healthcare delivery and management. Mobile and web applications built with the Core Framework enable health workers to submit health data via SMS messages or mobile applications, which can then be viewed and exported using a web application. The Core Framework addresses complexities like health system roles and reporting hierarchies, supporting a range of health programs and local care provider workflows. By equipping health workers with digital tools, the Core Framework contributes to improved healthcare outcomes in underserved communities.
